config_scope_note: The entire default BenchmarkConfig is recorded for reproducibility. Calibration, evaluation, document horizons and RNG settings do not trigger document generation in this diagnostic.

coverage.exclusions: No uniform interpolation bound, endpoint/extrapolation certification, inner-transform accuracy guarantee, mass-normalization check, document-path error bound or decision-level result is supplied by this diagnostic.
coverage.quantity: absolute error in within-branch marginal log likelihood ratio caused by outer logit-grid interpolation
coverage.reference: direct evaluation using the same positive quadrature grid and, for the shape branch, the same tabulated transform

purpose: Fresh production-grid numerical lookup validation; no generated documents or historical experiment measurements are represented.
